status_note: Mechanical RTX 5060 feasibility smoke on COCO val2017 development images. Not a performance result. G0 remains PENDING.

config.purpose: Claude G0 mechanical model-feasibility smoke on local development assets (COCO val2017 only). Not a performance test.
config.fit_rule: no CUDA OOM, no automatic batch reduction, finite losses, and torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved <= 7.5 GiB (below the 8 GB device so Windows sysmem fallback cannot hide an overflow)

selection.rule: Strata in order, each skipping images already claimed: crowded_count = most non-crowd person annotations (ties by sha256(seed:image_id)); iscrowd_person = >=1 iscrowd person; small_person = >=1 non-crowd person with COCO area < 1024; empty = no annotations; no_person_nonempty = annotations but no person/crowd-person; general = any. Within each non-count stratum, order by sha256(seed:image_id).

environment_pins.nvidia_smi: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU, 616.64, 8151 MiB, 98.06.45.40.18

det_eval_ultralytics.policy: existing det-eval-2d venv used read-only; nothing installed; freeze compared before/after the smoke

rtdetrv2.policy: new uv venv outside Git: uv venv --python 3.12; uv pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple --index-strategy unsafe-best-match torch==2.11.0+cu128 torchvision==0.26.0+cu128 'faster-coco-eval>=1.6.6' PyYAML tensorboard scipy packaging pycocotools (onnx/onnxruntime-gpu from requirements.txt omitted: export-only)

native_postprocessing.head: one-to-many (dense) + NMS
native_postprocessing.selection: conf > floor on max class score; class-aware torchvision hard NMS; iou=0.7; max_nms=30000 pre-NMS; max_det=300
native_postprocessing.multilabel: single label per box (predict path multi_label=False)
native_postprocessing.nms_time_limit: 2.0 + 0.05*batch seconds; on overrun Ultralytics logs a warning and stops
native_postprocessing.box_clipping: scale_boxes clips xyxy to the original image
